bootstrap.state: Prepared locally; remote creation and readback blocked by missing authorized administration capability.
bootstrap.meaning: Repository and planning setup only, no production service or dataset.
required_receipts: Public target repository identity and main commit
Foundational files and synthetic fixture labels
Actual organization Project identity, fields and saved-view readback
Issue IDs, native hierarchy/dependency readback and complete Project membership
Configured governance or exact access blockers

phases.name: Foundation
phases.gate: Accepted governance/contracts/source-use models and deterministic synthetic conformance; this is not production clearance.

phases.name: Bounded Pilot
phases.gate: Two eligible domain pilots, approved source capability, reviewed artifacts, consumer receipt, denial tests, and guarded rollback. Minimal versioned delivery/index and canonical-service import are prerequisites; broader exports remain outside pilot acceptance unless individually qualified.

phases.name: Beta
phases.gate: Actual compatible website/mobile handoffs, freshness/recovery behavior, controlled deployment and measured capacity within accepted limits.

phases.name: Production
phases.gate: Independent readiness review, accepted operating/recovery ownership and verified service evidence for the bounded released scope.

phases.name: Expansion
phases.gate: Each additional domain passes its own research, rights, quality, cost and consumer receiving gates.

forbidden_inferences: Passing bootstrap CI implies a deployed service
A research proposal or public source URL implies display/export permission
A schema-valid benchmark implies independent reproduction
A created issue or merged implementation PR implies all literal acceptance criteria are satisfied
A new snapshot implies historical builds expired
